data.body: [P1] Preserve the durable context across backoff completion. When another durable thread remains active, this wait can complete in-process on a polling/checkpoint thread. The continuation then calls `executeRetryLoop()`, which reads thread-local context and fails with `IllegalStateException` instead of starting the next attempt. Resume via a context-aware executor that restores the child durable context and logical thread state, or explicitly capture and restore both. Add an integration test with retry backoff and a concurrently running sibling operation.
